notes: All secrets are derived from public labels. Never use these keys outside tests.
Timestamps: unix seconds for createdAt/iat/exp/notBefore/oldValidTo; unix milliseconds for ts/hts.
noise.ikCacophonyKeys uses the cacophony keys and matches the cacophony.txt IK entry byte for byte (noise.cacophonyChecks).

Statements outside log.entries name the head at seq 3 as their base unless they belong to a folded chain (deviceLink.chain, deviceRekey.chain, log.foldChecks, log.refold, log.closure); standalone ones are format examples.
Every folded chain starts with log.entries[0..3]; chains and cases list only the entries after seq 3.
Field versions (ver) are log positions; -1 means the genesis value (room-log-v2.md section 4.0).
MLS commit entries are omitted from log.entries; epoch is 0 throughout.

sNotReduced.why: S replaced by S + L (same R)

sas.note: NhHex is the confirming device's nonce (link.nonce), not a host nonce

chain.prefix: log.entries[0..3], then these entries at seq 4, 5 and 6

cases.name: holdTooShort
cases.note: the requester is the member's only device, so the hold is 72 h, not 24 h

cases.name: baseBeforeRef
cases.note: the approval's base precedes the entry that carries ref (R-10)

cases.name: approvalAfterVeto
cases.note: the laptop vetoed the add at seq 6

cases.name: approvalAfterRequesterRemoved
cases.note: an admin removed the requesting (stolen, only) device at seq 6, which cancels its pending add in the fold (R-8)

cases.name: selfRemoveLastDevice
cases.note: a member's last device leaves with member.left (R-8)

chain.prefix: log.entries[0..3], then these entries at seq 4 and 5
chain.note: the requester is the member's only active device, so the rekey hold is 72 h (decision round 5, item 3)

cases.name: soleRekeyHoldTooShort
cases.note: the requester is the member's only device, so the rekey hold is 72 h, not 24 h (decision round 5, item 3)

vetoed.name: approvalAfterVeto
vetoed.note: the laptop, the device being rekeyed, vetoed the rekey at seq 5; the approval names the vetoed request

soleDeviceChangeAdmin.prefix: log.entries[0..3], then these entries at seq 4 to 6
soleDeviceChangeAdmin.note: room.policy.changed sets soleDeviceChange to "admin"; the sole device requests a rekey; an admin approves it interactively 1 h later

cases.name: autoApprovalAfterHold
cases.note: under soleDeviceChange "admin" a sole-device rekey needs an interactive admin approval, whatever the hold

foldChecks.prefix: log.entries[0..3], then roleChain[0..1] at seq 4 and 5; each case is a single entry at seq 6
notes: heldStatement was signed at the head of seq 3, before roleChain[0]; the forward-base rule rejects it (R-1 fix b).
abaStaleVersion names version 2 while the role is again 'watch' (version 5); an old-value check would have accepted it (R-1 fix a).

refold.prefix: log.entries[0..3], then these entries at seq 4, 5 and 6
notes: adminC (lineage of adminA) admits a ghost at seq 5; the recovery key revokes adminC from seq 5 at seq 6.
The ghost admission becomes suspect, the roster returns to the members of position 2, and the roster position becomes 6 (R-7).

closure.prefix: log.entries[0..3], then these entries at seq 4, 5 and 6
notes: The recovery key adds adminB, which starts its own lineage; adminA proposes; adminB confirms 25 h later.
Each case replaces seq 4 to 6 with case.chain (seq 4, 5) and case.entry (seq 6).
